scope: Acquisition and analysis of original fixed canonical BA observations only; no measurement, runtime or frozen-auditor changes.
independentSourceReview: Agent /root/jmdict_hotspots reviewed the helper and final run/job/census joins with no concrete blocker before artifact acquisition.
